newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent heads up after failing to breach support.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent heads up after failing to breach support.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures headed higher on technical buying after shrugging off a bearish API report on U.S. oil inventories, traders said.
Traders said Brent and NYMEX crude firmed on technically-led short covering after both markets had failed to break convincingly through supports at $19 and $20, respectively.
April Brent was up 33 cents at $19.57 a barrel at 1616 GMT.

"The big build in U.S. crude stocks was sufficient to push the markets through the psychological support but the failure to breach strong supports slightly under these levels triggered a fresh round of buying," one trader said.
